notes.title: Refund The Game
notes.content:
[p]Hey,[/p][p][/p][p]If you can't work out how to use the connection, the game probably doesn't work and we will be missing out on having you as a customer so much.

That said, just refund it, leave negative reviews, do whatever.

If you want to play the game and you want updates or anything, just join the Discord.[/p][p]If the negative review(s) puts you off, please do not buy the game, I don't want you messaging me asking more questions that are written on a FAQ. I don't care about your $2 bro.

Thanks,[/p][p]Ayrton[/p]

[h2]How to use !bot[/h2]

Just use !bot and then the intended command after:
```!bot !spawn```

You will need to be a mod or above to use this command and the bot will be tied to the Host streamer, the bot has it's own stats as per-usual.

notes.title: Bits Extension V0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey,

I've created a [url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/extensions/wulppddusj2rrix8dagmqdlh4cvzhv-0.1.0]Bits Extension[/url] upon suggestion. Viewers can currently use bits to activate 4 effects which the Streamer can set prices from within a range. 
[list]
[*] Double Gold x2 (15m)
[*] Double Gems x2 (15m)
[*] Force Nightmare Mode
[*] Spawn Skellington Blue
[/list]

The streamer won't be able to use it on their selves. It will not remove any bits from the Streamers. 80% of all Bits go to the Streamer and 20% to ChatTDT, you can find more info about this [url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/earning-revenue-from-bits-in-extensions?language=en_US]here[/url]!
Open to all feedback in the Discord or by e-mail!
support@ayrtonalexis.com

notes.title: V1.09.2 - Twitch Extension (No spam!)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Once the [url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/extensions/g7gsar2ibayea9e29um4gazv4yzsvy-0.0.1]extension[/url] gets [b]approved[/b] by [b]Twitch[/b], you will be able to [b]negate all spam[/b] by having [u][b]no commands in chat![/b][/u] Just add the [b]extension[/b] as a [b]panel[/b] and it can also be used on [b]Mobile[/b].
[i]Players can currently use the [url=https://ayrtonalexis.com/tdtweb.html]Web Browser[/url] version instead.[/i]

I have also added an [b][u]OBS_Output_Text.txt[/u][/b] in the [b]Game Install Directory[/b]; with this you can let [b]OBS[/b] [i][b]"Read from File"[/b][/i] and display the game's text on screen instead of in chat. You could also tie this to your own [b]Custom Scripts[/b].

As well as that, I have also added [b]Tower Skins[/b]. Play before [b][u]17/04[/u][/b] to receive the [u][b]"Dark Mage Slow Tower Skin"[/b][/u] for [b]free[/b]!

Players and streamers alike can choose their Tower Skin [url=https://ayrtonalexis.com/tdtuser.html]here[/url] after playing and saving past [u][b]V1.09.X[/b][/u]

If you want to stay up-to-date, I recommend joining the [url=https://discord.gg/pTcwdsA3tf]Discord[/url].

Thanks a lot!
Ayrton

Hey,

I have added the option for a cosmetic Golden Tower via [url=https://ayrtonalexis.com/tdtsupporter.html]this link[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080388/dbd4a311cee81de8c6150d99f8f16b048f63fd42.png[/img]

Thanks so much for all your support already, just playing is great enough!
